summary: United Fire Group Inc. filed an 8-K solely to announce the timing of its second quarter 2026 earnings release and conference call. The filing contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. This is a routine disclosure of an upcoming earnings announcement and call, which does not constitute a special situation under event-driven research criteria.
